reasons: This makes the samplewise comparator required by the arm expansions and the complete-subsample variance argument explicit; its definition does not assert the still-open feasible approximation.
The same oracle leading statistic must be defined at both the full-sample and refitted-subsample sizes.
The local-tail-index counterexample must target a procedure explicitly defined in this paper rather than an unnamed published method.
The joint likelihood and coherent propensity pair are expressed through the logistic link.
A genuinely global joint-Hessian bound is governed by the more singular of the two endpoint exponents.
The binary-coherent learner uses one log-odds function instead of two unrelated log-probability functions.
The constrained likelihood optimizes a single two-endpoint log-odds series.
The complete-subsample Hoeffding argument acts on one explicitly defined symmetric arm vector.
The arm theorem and complete-subsample argument require an explicit samplewise oracle comparator.
Both fitted propensities are generated from the same estimated log odds.
One constrained Bernoulli likelihood gives score \((A-\pi_1)v\), information \(E_P(\pi_0\pi_1v^2)\), and fitted probabilities that sum to one pointwise.
Perturbing one fitted arm without changing its complement violates binary coherence. The replacement preserves the target perturbation and defines the other arm as its complement.
The arm-vector algorithm is retained, every subsample now refits the coherent joint learner, and the previously unnamed raw scalar comparison is defined only as an internal diagnostic.
comparator-promise-table-replace: The replacement records conservative, source-scoped roles for every retained comparator and removes unsupported superiority and negative-method claims.
The claim is narrowed to the schedule actually proved for the joint fit and no longer depends on the unresolved uniform boundary-likelihood lemma.

narrow: After replacing the separate arm fits by one joint logit fit, sample-point control of the profiled treated-endpoint log direction requires the explicit mixed-witness condition \(J_n^{5/2}(\log n)^3/n\to0\). The old condition \(J_n\log n/n\to0\) alone does not control that direction. This narrows only the estimator schedule on the same mixed law and leaves the model class and conclusion unchanged.

closed_note: High-reasoning adjudication accepts the coherent joint-logit direction and partial open-obligation graph, but rejects the active e^{-J} range constraint (excludes alpha>1 candidates) and the unrestricted measurable chart geometry; close for one bounded canonical-chart/inactive-range repair before atomically reapplying.
